source.note: LRC revised text as retrieved: current law on that date, not a dated history.

provisions.heading: Prescribed level of income for excepted self-employed contributor.
provisions.effectiveClue: Substituted (1.01.2011) by Social Welfare (Consolidated Contributions and Insurability) (Amendment) Regulations 2010 (S.I. No. 684 of 2010), art. 6, in effect as per art. 2.
provisions.relevanceReason: Self-employment (Class S) contributions for sole traders and partners (issue #212).
provisions.excerpt:
92.
The prescribed
amount for the purposes of paragraph 3 of Part III of the First Schedule to the
Principal Act shall be

€5,000

in a contribution year.

versions.quote: shall be €5,000 in a contribution year.
